'''DRN-592''' was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]<ref name="GB" /> created by [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]]<ref name="Databank" /> who served as a [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] in the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].<ref name="GB" /> As with all B1-series [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], DRN-592 was 1.91 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] (6 [[Foot/Legends|feet]], 3 inches) tall,<ref name="TCWCE" /> weighed 65 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]],<ref name="TCW H2H" /> and had [[Gender/Legends|masculine programming]].<ref name="GB" /> The droid wielded an [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]]<ref name="Equipment" /> and had a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] equipped with an [[Antenna/Legends|antenna]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] had [[Color/Legends|light tan]] plating with brown markings.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
DRN-592 appeared in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', where he is available as a unique unit for players to use in custom made scenarios. When placed in a scenario, DRN-592's model uses different colors from their profile image, featuring the tan color common to other B1-Series battle droids on their head and parts of their [[Limb/Legends|limbs]], along with the color selected by the player's alignment on their chest and legs. The droid's model is identical to several other unique battle droid units. DRN-592's name can also appear as a Trade Federation AI commander in the standard game mode.<ref name="GB" />
